issue_summary: Linux password rotation failed shortly after onboarding
investigation_findings: Historical snapshot: selected account configuration differed from approved local-account record.
documented_outcome: Owner corrected configuration in a separate approved change; subsequent historical validation passed. Current failure has no collected error and is not diagnosed.

investigation_findings: Sanitized historical logs showed an account restriction at the failure timestamp.
documented_outcome: Owner reviewed the restriction through the approved process; historical follow-up succeeded.

investigation_findings: Historical monitoring showed target unavailable during rotation.
documented_outcome: Target owner restored availability through an approved change; later rotation succeeded.

investigation_findings: Account ownership approval was missing from the onboarding record.
documented_outcome: Owner supplied approval; onboarding review resumed.

investigation_findings: Two inventory entries referred to the same synthetic account.
documented_outcome: Owner identified intended record through approved inventory review.

issue_summary: Custom web connector login element missing
investigation_findings: Sanitized test screenshots showed a changed application element label.
documented_outcome: Connector owner updated the test configuration through an approved change and validated it.

investigation_findings: Historical execution reached an expired-session page.
documented_outcome: Application owner documented expected session flow; approved test validation completed.

investigation_findings: Historical test encountered an interactive challenge unsupported by the documented integration.
documented_outcome: Escalated to application and security owners; no bypass attempted.

issue_summary: Password rotation rejected by target policy
investigation_findings: Historical sanitized error indicated minimum password age rejection.
documented_outcome: Owner aligned the approved schedule after policy review; historical validation passed.

issue_summary: Linux post-change verification mismatch after attempted rotation
investigation_findings: Historical sanitized workflow reported an attempted password update followed by failed verification; records did not establish which credential state remained valid.
documented_outcome: Owner initiated an approved credential-state investigation rather than blindly repeating rotation. The current LNX-005 mismatch is likewise not diagnosed by the old ticket.

issue_summary: Windows domain password change rejected by minimum-age policy
investigation_findings: Historical sanitized error identified a minimum password age restriction for an attempted change on the domain-managed account.
documented_outcome: Policy owner reviewed the historical schedule through an approved process; no policy bypass was attempted. Current WIN-003 rejection requires separate evidence review.

issue_summary: Windows account-management request blocked by missing authorization
investigation_findings: A historical request to prepare a future password-management workflow was blocked because approval for required account permissions had not been recorded; no actual rotation ran.
documented_outcome: Request remained on hold for owner authorization. The incident was not a successful or failed production password change.

issue_summary: Custom web connector misses password field on second login screen
investigation_findings: Historical sanitized test reached the username screen, then failed to identify the next password field on a conditional second page.
documented_outcome: Application owner documented the expected two-stage login flow; a separate approved test review was requested. No interactive control was bypassed.

issue_summary: Custom web connector blocked by untrusted HTTPS certificate
investigation_findings: A historical sanitized browser error identified that the target HTTPS certificate was not trusted by the connector host.
documented_outcome: The historical issue was referred for approved trust-store review. Certificate validation was not disabled, and this finding does not diagnose the present APP-004 login issue.

issue_summary: Web login form submitted without confirmed authenticated session
investigation_findings: Historical test navigated past the submit step but lacked evidence of the required post-login success indicator.
documented_outcome: Owner requested a documented login-success indicator for an approved test. The historical form submission was not treated as proof of authentication.
